item.title: Bulletin updated at 02:50 HKT 27/Feb/2026
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Under the influence of a broad trough of low pressure, there will be occasional showers and isolated thunderstorms over southern China today and tomorrow. A strong easterly airstream will affect the coast of Guangdong during the weekend. With the easterly airstream being replaced by a humid southerly airstream early next week, it will be warm during the day and there will still be a few showers over the coast of southern China. The northeast monsoon and its replenishments are expected to bring a few rain patches to southern China in the middle to latter parts of next week. It will be slightly cooler over the region.
